· RSI 궤적 (31.0→42.1) — 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 진입 시도 중, 방향성 약함
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-3.0001→-1.4222) — 음수 구간에서 개선 중이나 약세 전환 신호는 미흡
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $348.24) — 중단 부근 횡보하며 방향성 부재
[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($340.49) — SMA20 및 피벗 PP 기반 저항
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low) — 저점은 높아지고 있으나 고점은 낮아지는 패턴으로 횡보 구간 진단
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.80배) — 평균 이하 거래량으로 움직임의 신뢰도 낮음
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) — RSI 과매도 탈출 및 Higher Low 패턴은 긍정적이나, MACD 개선 미흡, ADX 무추세, 거래량 부재로 매수 진입은 어렵고 관망 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($333.66) vs SMA5/20/50 ($330.08/$348.24/$359.31) — Above SMA5, below SMA20/50 indicating short-term weak trend and mid-term downtrend.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($346.91/$325.41) — Below SMA100, above SMA200 showing mixed mid-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (66.1%) + current price level is historically in the middle range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.0→42.1) — Attempting to enter neutral zone after exiting oversold, weak directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.0001→-1.4222) — Improving in negative territory but insufficient signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $348.24) — Sideways movement around the middle band indicating lack of direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($330.20) — Support based on SMA5 and 5-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($340.49) — Resistance based on SMA20 and Pivot PP.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) — Lower lows are rising, but highs are falling, indicating a consolidation phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.80x) — Below average volume, indicating low confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — RSI exiting oversold and Higher Low pattern are positive, but weak MACD improvement, no ADX trend, and lack of volume make buying difficult; maintaining a 'watch' stance.
